company_name: Xiamen Innovacera Advanced Materials Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides advanced ceramic materials that are critical for addressing thermal, electrical, mechanical, and vacuum challenges in semiconductor applications.
summary: Xiamen Innovacera Advanced Materials Co., Ltd specializes in the development and manufacturing of advanced ceramic materials such as Alumina, Zirconia, Boron Nitride, and Aluminum Nitride.
